purpose: Shared node/edge contract for LOC Graph RAG and Search Synthesis. Search retrieval chooses graph seeds; governed edges aggregate related LOC, ERA, works, media and analysis without replacing canonical ownership.
rules: Graph nodes are references to authoritative records, not replacement copies.
Canonical edges require explicit registry evidence, authoritative metadata, or deterministic structural evidence.
Semantic similarity may select seed nodes but must never create a canonical edge by itself.
ERA-P0 through current ERA form a deterministic temporal backbone from LOC_ERA_REGISTRY.
Search-time result nodes may receive transient owned_by_loc, belongs_to_era, and media/work linkage edges from their own recorded metadata.
Graph traversal is bounded and feeds Search Synthesis with connected LOCs, ERA paths, works, media and analysis nodes.
LOC7 manages graph structure/retrieval; LOC8 owns ERA/context authority and consumes graph projections for trend/context views.
LOC8 repository snapshots may contribute public temporal/event observation nodes without replacing the live Google Sheet authority.
Private LOC8 Google Sheet Relation rows are never exposed through public Search unless they are explicitly governed into a public registry/snapshot.
Search responses expose a provenance envelope summarizing source_refs and graph evidence kinds/status.

search_synthesis.seed_source: Unified Search results + exact query-to-node matches

provenance.public_relation_policy: Only repository-governed public snapshots/registries are exposed. Live private LOC8 Relation rows remain in life.html / Google Sheet.
